beats.summary: Dwight brings authentic New York bagels to the office, offering them to coworkers to create favors owed to him.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Good morning everybody. Who would like an authentic New York bagel?
Dwight: Can't a guy just buy some bagels for his friends so they'll owe him a favor which he can use to get someone fired who stole a co-manager position from him anymore?

beats.summary: Michael is dating Pam's mother Helene, and plans a birthday lunch for her involving office staff.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Birthday lunch. Birthday lunch– there is no better medicine than birthday lunch.
Pam: Michael's been trying to get Jim and me to hang out ever since he started dating my mom.

beats.summary: Pam receives an urgent call about a shipping emergency, threatening her attendance at Helene's birthday lunch.

evidence.snippet: Creed: Something's up. That paper was never supposed to arrive.

evidence.snippet: Andy: You give me a gift– Bam! Thank you note. You invite me somewhere– Pow! RSVP. You do me a favor– Wham! Favor returned.
